long_biography.plain_text:
Heather Hart helped shape Inspired Acts, California Pizza Kitchen's employee volunteering initiative. In 2015, more than 800 staff members joined Hart and her family at Camp Pendleton to build playgrounds, paint facilities and landscape outdoor areas for military families. The programme reflected an emphasis on practical, organised service rather than occasional charitable events.

Hart also participated in James Madison University's Women in Leadership conference and joined her family in supporting hospitality education. The couple's giving was intended to help young people enter public-serving careers. The school bearing the Hart name serves students in hospitality, sport and recreation management.
